annotation.title_clean: UCHWAŁA NR 196 RADY MINISTRÓW z dnia 28 grudnia 2020 r. w sprawie ustanowienia „Polityki dla rozwoju sztucznej inteligencji w Polsce od roku 2020”
annotation.title_en: Resolution No. 196 of the Council of Ministers of 28 December 2020 establishing the "Policy for the Development of Artificial Intelligence in Poland from 2020"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Rada Ministrów Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej (Council of Ministers of Poland)
annotation.summary_en: Polish Council of Ministers resolution adopting the national AI Policy from 2020. It sets short-, medium- and long-term goals across society, business, science, education, international cooperation and the public sector, covering funding, talent, data, ethics and legal frameworks. It excludes defence and security, and has no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Polish AI Policy; the minister responsible for digitalisation is the implementing body.
The minister must report annually to the Council of Ministers by 1 September, starting in 2021.
Goals are set for 2023, 2027 and the long term in six areas: society, business, science, education, international cooperation and the public sector.
Legal framework directions include a legal definition of AI, opposing legal personhood for AI, and fault-based liability for AI producers but risk-based liability for operators.
Excludes national security and defence, but supports civil-military cooperation.
